status: draft contract in execution; user-directed 2026-11-11 (one-hour tests, this PC only, no spending); not the road-car contract
relation_to_v1: wp9-replication-baseline-v1.json (road-car benchmark, 12M-cell floor) is unchanged and unmet. No fast-tier row is a v1 result and none relabels a v1 verdict.

budget.budget_exhausted_is: fail (budget), reported with the averaging so far and its interval

method.mesh: snappyHexMesh half model with symmetry plane, about 0.5M cells (dx0 0.092 m on the classic body), 5 prism layers
method.start: steady k-omega SST, 500..2000 iterations, used as the initial field and as a labelled trend only
method.solver: pimpleFoam, kOmegaSSTDDES, delta maxDeltaxyz, DEShybrid linear/linearUpwind momentum convection, limited k/omega gradients, turbulence on every outer loop, outer residual control, fixed time step, running averages of U and p from the wash-out end
method.domain_option: VERNON_FAST_DOMAIN_BOX (upstream, downstream, width, height in metres) replaces the blockage-sized tunnel; the dataset's tunnel (2.956, 6.0, 2.0, 1.4; 4.0% blockage) gave Cd 0.263 against 0.264 in the default 2% tunnel (2026-11-17).
method.body_resolution_option: VERNON_FAST_BODY_LEVEL (body surface level, default 4: 5.75 mm at dx0 0.092), VERNON_FAST_LAYERS (default 5) and VERNON_FAST_TET_CHECK (mesh option tet_quality_check, default off). Level 5 (2.875 mm) fails in the first pressure solve at the full step with 5 or 3 layers, with or without the tet check: snapped cells on the body radii reach Courant 28 (level 4: 13-17); half the step runs but cannot average and check within the hour (2026-11-17). The dataset steps at 1/1300-1/2600 CTU against our 1/91.
method.turbulence_model_option: les_model: kOmegaSSTDDES (default) or SpalartAllmarasDDES (the slant-body dataset's model; nuTilda free stream 10 nu, started from the steady nut). Each row records its model; on the 0.45M validation grid SA-DDES read Cd 0.264 against SST-DDES 0.251 (2026-11-16); on the 0.88M grid both read 0.244-0.245 (2026-11-17), so the model is not the cause of the gap to the reference.
method.time_step: fixed, an integer number of steps per convective unit (default 100), requested from the wake Courant number, never from Cd; checked by the half-step segment
limitations: half model: the symmetry plane suppresses side-to-side wake motion; the open datasets ran full bodies
about 0.5M cells against references of 20M (slant-body dataset) and about 300M (Windsor dataset) cells; the reported error includes that grid difference
the DDES delta and convection blend differ from the reference solvers; this is a method comparison, not a reproduction

acceptance.source: docs/research/wp9-ddes-route-plan.md section 3.1 (v2 draft), implemented in crates/vernon-nodes-cfd/src/transient.rs
acceptance.deliverable: the time-weighted mean Cd with its 95% interval (1.96 x the larger standard-error estimate); the effective sample size and both standard-error estimates are reported, not gated
acceptance.deliverable_change_log: 2026-11-12, user decision 'Reported interval' after run fast-slant25-20261112-c reached the 15 CTU cap with ESS 10 and a 2.1% standard error: the v2 limits (ESS >= 50, s.e. <= 0.5%) stay in TransientParams::v2 for the road-car contract and are switched off in TransientParams::fast_tier. Stationarity (trend, halves), the per-step rule, the half-step agreement, mesh quality and the budget remain gates. The band comparison reports both the mean's error and whether the interval overlaps the band.
acceptance.std_err_estimate: larger of autocorrelation (Geyer) and batch means with 1 CTU blocks

per_step.change_log: 2026-11-11, before any certified run: the draft's absolute p limit (1e-4 at the final corrector) was replaced by the same one-order drop used for U, k and omega. A step-cost probe on the 0.5M-cell slant body (Courant about one in the wake) showed p initial residuals of about 1e-3 at the last outer loop with each step converging by two orders; an absolute limit would reward small time steps, as the engineering review warned. The outer-loop residual control written to fvSolution is ignored by this solver release ('no residual control data found'), so the three outer loops always run.

half_step_segment.agreement: difference of means within the combined 95% interval (a shorter half-step window widens the allowed difference accordingly)
half_step_segment.change_log: 2026-11-11, before any certified run: averaging shortened from 2 to 1 CTU so the check fits inside the one-hour budget at the measured 2.2 s/step

acceptance.stop_rule: evaluated at every check boundary from the minimum; stop at the first pass or at the cap; stopping never depends on Cd relative to the band
